blank_size_scope: Inherited 057/042 nominal blank plan. This size at R10 finished thin gauge is not confirmed by the SR-200 catalog; smaller blanks require a revised joining bill.
retained_shape_hardware_scope: PROJECTION: 0.004 kg/m2 retained targets plus 0.016 kg/m2 local shims/filler. Temporary adjusters and jig removed. No distributed flight back structure is credited.
cost_scope: First completed shell and its listed systems/allocations, panel manufacturing, seams, temporary jig/hall/handling, metrology/NDE and coupon/process/subscale qualification, with explicit cost contingency. All rates are unquoted 2026 USD planning assumptions. Full-scale destructive qualification or replacement hull, land, financing, taxes and operations are not priced; their costs are unknown, not zero. This is not a qualified-flight procurement total.

pricing_basis.Be_USD_kg: Inherited 042 planning range 10-50k USD/kg, explicitly PROJECTION, not sourced vendor quotation. Takeoff is the full rectangular blank count at nominal gauge before scarf trimming, divided by additional purchased_stock_yield (0.90/0.70) for process/procurement loss. Forming/preparation separate. No scrap recovery credited.
pricing_basis.other_rates: Owner-selected transparent planning assumptions for route comparison, not published price or performance guarantees.
pricing_basis.inflation: No historical cost index assumed. Historical telescope contracts remain in their stated dollar year and are comparisons only.
